documentation: Grandfathered front-end debt, frozen at the values docs/FRONTEND.md's
Adoption section legislates. Every number and every entry here may only
shrink; the checks that read this file are tests/test_frontend_ratchets.py
and tests/js/module-isolation.test.mjs. The front-end architecture epic's
closeout deletes this file once every list is empty.
inline_script_ceilings: exact permitted count of inline-script source
lines per Jinja template (docs/FRONTEND.md, Modules: templates carry no
logic in <script>). The metric is defined in tests/test_frontend_ratchets.py
and is enforced as an equality, so moving glue into a module fails the
check until the ceiling is lowered in the same pull request. A template
absent from this map must carry no inline script.
module_injection_placeholders: the `{{ name | safe }}` lines each template
may use inside a <script> element to inline a module. Placeholder lines are
excluded from the line count, so an unregistered one would be an unmeasured
way to inject Python-built script; registering them makes an added
injection point a checked change. Placeholders outside every <script> —
the shell's head links, band, and footer fragments — are not covered here.
fstring_documents: functions under src/election_guide whose own body holds
a `<!doctype`-leading string literal (docs/FRONTEND.md, Server-side
templates). A document held at module scope is not covered.
module_isolation_exemptions: client modules that do not yet load
standalone in Node (docs/FRONTEND.md, Modules: every .mjs is a real ES
module). `error` is matched as a substring of the load failure, so an
exemption cannot silently start covering a different defect.
